recipe: KISIC – Imaging Centre Kisasi – full model build recipe
version: 2026-10-19 r1 (after Revit crash; replays everything built so far + everything still to build)
how_to_run: Revit 2025 open. Ctrl+N → Metric Multi-discipline (Default-Multi-Discipline_Metric.rte) → Project. Do NOT save; the person saves at the end over D:\Fomcraft\FMC_PROJECTS_27\KISASI IMAGING CENTRE\01_WIP\A\KISIC-FMC-ZZ-ZZ-M3-A-0001.rvt
Run the steps below in order with send_code_to_revit on the unsaved document (document = its title, e.g. Project1). Each script takes parameter 'dry' (rolls back) or 'real'.
One step per call. Never two model-changing scripts in parallel. After each real run: export the check view (step 03) and read it before moving on.
Families are built with fmc_doc (open template → apply ops → save to 04_Families\_Staging\<Role>) and loaded by the step scripts.

frame.units: metres in this file; scripts convert to mm
frame.origin: inside face, north-west corner of the X-ray room
frame.axes: +x east, +y south on plan. Revit X = x, Revit Y = -y
frame.phases: Existing structure (walls, slabs, existing doors) = phase Existing. Everything we add (fit-out, MEP, furniture) = New Construction. Structure does not change.

steps.name: Existing shell
steps.status: built and checked once (lost in the crash) – replay
steps.wall_type: Generic - 150mm Masonry (template); location line = wall centreline

walls_centreline.note: slanted façade; inner face 8.74 at y=0 so Scan width = 3.29
ends 10 mm inside the façade centreline so the T-join forms (exact centreline did not join)

steps.join_rule: Every wall end sits on another wall's centreline. After creation: AllowWallJoinAtEnd on both ends; verify every end has ElementsAtJoin ≠ empty (20/20). Fail the step otherwise.

list.note: centre 2.93 keeps the frame 80 mm clear of W-CTL-S join

ceiling.phase: New Construction (it is part of the fit-out)
ceiling.later: split per room in step 05 when the light layout is fixed

steps.name: Check views
steps.what: FMC Check - Plan (own plan view, no view template, crop to model, 1:50, room tags) and FMC Check - 3D (section box, roof + ceiling hidden, levels hidden, crop to section box). Exports PNGs to 01_WIP\A\_check. Run after every step.

steps.name: LED strips (horizontal round every room + one vertical corner run) and veranda strip
steps.family: FMC_E_LightFixture_StripLED.rfa – built and saved in _Staging\E (survived the crash). Face-based, Lighting Fixtures, instance Length, Body/Diffuser material params, types 14Wpm_24V and 10Wpm_24V-IP65 (FMC_Power_W per metre – ASSUMED).

rules.horizontal: on the room-side face of every bounding wall, 150 mm below the ceiling (z 2850), inset 30 mm from each corner, one piece per wall segment
rules.vertical: one run per room from z 300 to z 2800 at the start corner of the chosen boundary segment
rules.veranda: type 10Wpm_24V-IP65 on the outside face of W-S at z 2600, 9.5 m, own switch V1
rules.switching: every room's strip on its own switch (X2, C2, S2 dimmer, B2, L4), veranda V1 separate

steps.crash_note: Revit crashed (fatal error) during the first strip run. Suspect: creating AppearanceAssetElement copies + AppearanceAssetEditScope (self-illumination) inside the same transaction as LoadFamily and placement. The new script does NOT touch appearance assets; materials are created plain. Self-illumination is set in step 04b on its own, or in Enscape's material editor.

step_04b.what: give FMC_LED_Diffuser_Opal_3000K a self-illuminating appearance (luminance ≈1500 cd/m², 3000 K) – run alone, with Revit saved-state nothing to lose; if it crashes again, do it in Enscape (Material Editor → Self Illumination) instead

steps.name: Light fittings (simple Ugandan products) + switches

families_needed.status: staged, light source ON (1400/900 lm, 3000 K, spot 100/120°)
spec only – build: surface 600x600 36 W ≈3600 lm 4000 K, rectangle light source
NOT in the kit – kit change request; build: 52" (1320 mm) 4-blade fan, 300 mm drop rod, 18 W LED light kit ≈1600 lm 3000 K
spec only – build 1200_36W-Surface (under-shelf 600 mm 9 W variant)
families_needed.use: lab task B3, control task C3

placements.note: 3 along the south wall from the lab door

steps.switches: beside each door on the lock side: lobby bank at D08 entrance (L1–L8) and by reception; X-ray bank by D01 inside; Control by D02; Scan by D03 (dimmers); Lab by D05; veranda V1/V2 inside by D07

steps.name: Electrical (power, data, DB)

elements.DB: proposed on the reception wall beside the lab door (W-LAB-E lobby face, x 4.15, y ≈ 5.0, 1.6 m to top) – confirm existing
elements.circuits: P1–P18 per Sheet 04 (lighting P1–P4, sockets P5–P7, equipment P8–P12, AC P13–P16, heaters P17, pump P18)
elements.sockets: 13 A BS 1363: lobby/reception doubles + TV high level + phone charging; lab worktop doubles at 1.1 m; scan dedicated (backup) at couch head; control + reception on backup; veranda weatherproof RCD
elements.isolators: X-ray generator (in Control), one per AC indoor unit, water heaters
elements.data: reception rack + 2 points, control 1–2, scan 1, lab analyser 1, TV 1
elements.containment: PVC conduit in the ceiling void and chased down walls (existing walls: surface trunking where chasing is not allowed)

steps.families: M_Duplex Receptacle (replace with an FMC 13A socket family from the kit if staged), M_Data Outlet, M_Lighting and Appliance Panelboard as DB placeholder
steps.rule: Ratings and circuit sizes are placeholders for the licensed electrician (kit rule 5)

steps.name: Mechanical (AC + fresh air)
steps.source: canvas Sheet 05 + the 3-room options message (A two splits / B multi-split / C ducted)
steps.decision_needed: the person picks A, B or C for X-ray/Control/Scan

units.size: 12k BTU on area (Sheet 05 said 18k with high ceiling + equipment heat) – final from heat load
units.indoor: wall split, X-ray west wall high level
north wall, blowing along the room not onto the couch

3d_model.option_A_B: indoor units (Mechanical Equipment), refrigerant pair as pipe (Other system, 10/16 mm Cu insulated) straight up through the ceiling void and roof slab to the outdoor unit on a raised frame; condensate 20 mm PVC falling to the outside wall → gully
3d_model.option_C: concealed ducted unit over the X-ray/Control lobby ceiling void (z 3000–3400); rectangular supply duct 300x150 to linear grilles in X-ray, Control, Scan; one return grille in the lobby; lead-lined/offset section where the duct passes the shielded wall
3d_model.fresh_air: transfer grilles in D01/D04 (light-tight) and D03; Scan exhaust fan 150 mm through the north wall

steps.families: kit AC indoor/outdoor families if staged; else M_Air Handling Unit - Split System - Vertical is NOT right – build FMC_M_AC_Split_Indoor (wall) and FMC_M_AC_Split_Outdoor with pipe connectors

steps.name: Plumbing
steps.pipes: Domestic Cold Water from mains (entry TBC) + roof tank 1,000–2,000 L; hot from point heaters; Sanitary 40/50 mm PVC out through outside walls to gullies G1–G4; veranda channel drain G5; AC condensate to G1–G4

steps.name: Furniture, equipment, planting

items.item: Reception desk with joinery LED + magazine rack on the front
TV on flexible arm, south wall above door head
built-in benches 0.45 deep, planters, green screen, roll-down blinds, canopy extension 0.6 m

steps.sources: kit families first (fmc_context for_task), else build; Enscape asset library for plants/people/decor in the render only

steps.name: Views, Enscape scenes and video
steps.video: Enscape fly-through: veranda → entrance → lobby → reception → X-ray lobby → scan; evening light

steps.name: Hand-over
steps.what: final QA (walls joined, doors clear, no orphan fixtures, MEP connected), then the PERSON saves over the KISIC path. After saving, the live-model lock applies; further changes go through the person or Fix-with-approval.

open_items: roof build-up for AC units and tank
